market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. US-Iran conflict drives oil/inflation spike, rate-hike expectations pressure equities and bonds simultaneously. Nasdaq correction likely extends 5-10%. Bond yields may test 5% on 10Y. EM stress could trigger contagion. Bank strikes Sept 11 add operational risk. Expect high volatility (VIX >25).
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if Iran conflict de-escalates within 60-90 days. Rate-hike cycle likely brief if inflation proves transitory. Tech leadership (NVDA, AAPL post-Cook) remains structurally strong. US debt trajectory (Trump's 20% growth claim) is a medium-term fiscal risk. EM recovery possible post-stabilization. Consumer weakness may moderate by Q1 2027.
